def design(feats):
    X = np.asarray(feats.x, float); y = np.asarray(feats.y, float); n, p = X.shape
    ids = list(feats.ids)
    labs = sorted(set(feats.stratum))
    S = np.ones((n, 1))
    if len(labs) > 1:
        st = np.array(feats.stratum)
        S = np.column_stack([np.ones(n)] + [(st == l).astype(float) for l in labs[1:]])

    def ll(Z):
        b = np.zeros(Z.shape[1])
        for _ in range(30):
            eta = np.clip(Z @ b, -30, 30); mu = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-eta))
            w = mu * (1 - mu) + 1e-9
            H = Z.T @ (Z * w[:, None]) + 1e-6 * np.eye(Z.shape[1])
            step = np.linalg.solve(H, Z.T @ (y - mu)); b += step
            if np.max(np.abs(step)) < 1e-7: break
        mu = np.clip(1 / (1 + np.exp(-np.clip(Z @ b, -30, 30))), 1e-12, 1 - 1e-12)
        return float(np.sum(y * np.log(mu) + (1 - y) * np.log(1 - mu)))

    R = np.corrcoef(X, rowvar=False)
    sel = []
    base = ll(S)
    for k in range(MAX_DRIVERS):
        alpha = (0.05 if k == 0 else 0.01) / p
        best, bj = None, -1
        for j in range(p):
            if j in sel or any(abs(R[j, s]) >= 0.6 for s in sel): continue
            v = ll(np.column_stack([S] + [X[:, s] for s in sel + [j]]))
            if best is None or v > best: best, bj = v, j
        if bj < 0 or stats.chi2.sf(2 * (best - base), 1) > alpha: break
        sel.append(bj); base = best
    changed = True
    while changed and len(sel) > 1:
        changed = False
        full = ll(np.column_stack([S] + [X[:, s] for s in sel]))
        pv = [stats.chi2.sf(2 * (full - ll(np.column_stack([S] + [X[:, t] for t in sel if t != s]))), 1) for s in sel]
        w = int(np.argmax(pv))
        if pv[w] > 0.01 / p: sel.pop(w); changed = True
    for i in range(len(sel)):
        others = [X[:, t] for t in sel if t != sel[i]]
        fit = lambda j: ll(np.column_stack([S] + others + [X[:, j]]))
        alts = [j for j in range(p) if abs(R[j, sel[i]]) >= 0.6 and j not in sel]
        if alts:
            bj = max(alts, key=fit)
            if fit(bj) > fit(sel[i]): sel[i] = bj
    M = np.column_stack([S] + [X[:, s] for s in sel])
    m0 = ll(M)
    npairs = p * (p + 1) // 2
    cands = []
    for a in range(p):
        for b in range(a, p):
            if a != b and abs(R[a, b]) >= 0.6: continue
            extra = [X[:, c] for c in (a, b) if c not in sel]
            Z0 = np.column_stack([M] + extra) if extra else M
            l0 = ll(Z0) if extra else m0
            l1 = ll(np.column_stack([Z0, X[:, a] * X[:, b]]))
            pv = stats.chi2.sf(2 * (l1 - l0), 1)
            if pv < 0.01 / npairs: cands.append((pv, a, b))
    cands.sort()
    prods = []
    for pv, a, b in cands:
        if len(prods) >= 2: break
        if any({a, b} & {c, d} for c, d in prods): continue
        prods.append((a, b))
    drivers = list(sel)
    for a, b in prods:
        for c in (a, b):
            if c not in drivers: drivers.append(c)
    drivers = drivers[:MAX_DRIVERS]
    cols = sorted(set(sel) | {c for pr in prods for c in pr})
    return Design(drivers=tuple(ids[j] for j in drivers), columns=tuple(ids[j] for j in cols),
                  products=tuple((ids[a], ids[b]) for a, b in prods), loadings={})
